title: blemees-workflow state machine
description: Schema for `*-states.json` files. Provides editor / IDE feedback on structure and enum values; cross-field rules (terminal-taxonomy presence, claim-only-on-resting, gate-only-when-hitl, cross_process metadata, etc.) are enforced by the Python parser + validator and surface via `workflow validate`.

$schema.description: Optional schema URI for editor support.

name.description: Process name. Defaults to the file stem with `-states` stripped. The HCP catalog path is derived from this by convention: `<name>-hcps.json`.

roles.description: Role ids permitted to occupy this working state. REQUIRED on working states; FORBIDDEN on resting / terminal states. Resting states are open queues; downstream working states declare who may pick items up.

issue_types.description: Issue type ids this working state accepts. REQUIRED on working states; FORBIDDEN on resting / terminal states. The process's overall accepted set is derived as the union of every working state's `issue_types`.

reversibility.description: How reversible landing in this state is. REQUIRED on resting and terminal states; FORBIDDEN on working states (working states are transient — only landings have a reversibility class). Enforced by the Python parser.

terminal_taxonomy.description: Required on terminal states; forbidden elsewhere (enforced by parser). See state-machine-principles.md#8.

close_reason.description: Backend close-reason hint. REQUIRED on terminal states, FORBIDDEN elsewhere. For GitHub: 'completed' or 'not planned'.

handoff.description: Marks a resting state as a cross-process handover. The same state name must appear in at least one other process (also with `handoff: true`). Only valid on resting states.

spawns.description: Subprocess / spawn contract. Only valid on working or terminal states. Working states wait for the child to close, then auto-advance per `on_terminal`. Terminal states spawn an independent follow-up (no `on_terminal`).

issue_type.description: Child issue type (must be in target process's accepted types).

initial_state.description: Child's starting state on the target process (must be resting).

on_terminal.description: Map {child-terminal-state: parent-next-state}. Required on working-state spawns; must exhaustively cover every terminal on the target process. Forbidden on terminal-state spawns.

notes.description: Free prose to render in the mermaid output. Not parsed for semantics.

source.description: State id, or `[*]` for the entry sentinel.

destination.description: State id, or `[*]` for the exit sentinel.

label.description: Human-readable transition label. Optional except on `external` transitions (which have no auto-default). When absent, the parser auto-generates a structural label (e.g., `{role} claims {source}` for claim; `{role} → {dest}` for advance).

hitl.description: Marks the transition as a HITL gate. `gate` becomes required when true.

gate.description: HCP catalog `gate_name`. Required when `hitl: true` (enforced by parser).

kind.description: Required when `type` is `cross_process`. `shared` = same work item continues on the other process; `spawn` = new work item starts there.

process.description: Required when `type` is `cross_process`. Name of the other process.
